characterList.description: A man with a beard wearing a checkered white and red headscarf. He is wearing a shirt with a golden pattern and a white undershirt. He is sitting on a black chair with a white background.
characterList.name: Man

content_metadata.description: A step-by-step guide on how to perform prayers behind an imam, covering necessary actions, intentions, and recitations.

qAndA.question: What color is the man's headscarf?

qAndA.answer: Join a Jamaat, a prayer congregation.
qAndA.question: What does the man say is the first thing someone must do to pray behind an imam?
What is the first action the man instructs viewers to take during prayer?
What does the man say viewers should do when the imam finishes reciting Surah Fatiha?

qAndA.answer: Write it in the comment section.
qAndA.question: What does the man say should be done if there are any confusions?

videoEditingDetails.description: Intro with animated geometric figures and music changing between coral, dark blue and white backgrounds

scenes.contextualRelevance: Detailed guide for following an imam during prayers

narrativeProgression.description: The man welcomes viewers and states the topic of the video - how to pray behind an imam
He explains that for praying behind an imam it is necessary to join a Jamaat (prayer congregation)
He states that lining up straight is a must and those not lining up are engaging in other things
He instructs viewers to make their intention when the imam calls out "Allahu Akbar"
He tells viewers to say the "Sana" prayer silently
He tells viewers to say "Ameen" after the imam finishes reciting Surah Fatiha
He instructs viewers to remain silent as the imam recites the other verses of the Quran
He explains how to follow the imam's actions (standing, bowing, prostrating) during prayer
He advises viewers to say "Allahu Akbar" while bowing (ruku) and recite tasbih
He explains the sequence of actions and recitations for the remaining prayer, including prostration (sajdah)
He explains the second rakat of the prayer
He explains how to conclude the prayer with tashahhud, durood sharif, dua e masura, and salam
He addresses viewers to ask questions in the comments if they need clarification
He clarifies how to follow the imam during Zuhr and Asr prayers when the imam recites quietly
He reiterates the importance of following the imam's lead throughout the prayer
He concludes the video, asking viewers to like, share, and subscribe to the channel for more Islamic content.
